name: Advance Grinding Services
verdict: Google Business Profile is the only active channel driving engagement, with 172 total actions over 28 days (128 directions, 41 web clicks, 3 calls) across 25 days with impressions. The biggest movement is a 26.32% drop in Search Console clicks over the past 7 days versus the prior 7 days, likely reflecting reduced organic search visibility, while GBP actions held relatively steady with a modest 3.7% gain.

performance.verdict: Paid channels silent; organic holding but Search Console erosion is the live risk.

findings.text: 4 overdue CRM milestones (oldest: Jul 7): 342 stub reconciliation blocker unresolved past Aug 31 deadline, stalling Sales-i sync for those accounts.
2 overdue Aug 31 blockers unresolved: Web/SEO root cause unfiled and outreach contact pull (AGS + Forte) not delivered, gating downstream activity.
Search Console clicks fell 26.32% (7d vs prior 7d); 3-day signal confirms it — last 3 days (Sep 13–15) total 0 clicks vs prior 3 (Sep 10–12) total 26.
GBP actions held at +3.7% (7d), but last 2 days (Sep 14–15) show 0 actions each — possible weekend/data-lag effect, worth watching across 3 full days.
Zero paid spend, zero leads, zero GA4 sessions across the entire 28-day window and all 28 series days — no paid channel is active for this client.

suggestions.text: Escalate 342-stub reconciliation blocker to Ahmed — unresolved 16 days past Aug 31 deadline, blocking Sales-i sync.
suggestions.monday_update: The 342 stub account reconciliation was due Aug 31 and remains unresolved as of Sep 16 — 16 days overdue. This is a confirmed blocker: Sales-i cannot sync any of these accounts until Customer IDs are matched, meaning inactivity automations and re-engagement triggers are misfiring or silent for that entire segment. Ahmed to post reconciliation batch progress (with rollback file) to the Monday CRM board by Sep 19. Success check: all 342 stubs have a matched or flagged status in the board by that date.

suggestions.text: File Web/SEO root cause report and deliver AGS + Forte outreach contact pull — both Aug 31 blockers, now 16 days late.
suggestions.monday_update: Two separate Aug 31 blockers remain open: the Web/SEO root cause has not been named or submitted, and the AGS + Forte contact pull for cold outreach has not been delivered. Each gates a downstream workstream. Responsible parties to post updates to Monday by Sep 19: SEO team names the root cause and submits a fix plan; outreach team delivers the contact list. Success check: both Monday items move to 'In Review' status with deliverables attached by Sep 19.

suggestions.text: Watch Search Console clicks: 0 for 3 straight days (Sep 13–15) vs 26 prior 3 days — re-check Sep 19 for recovery or ranking drop.
suggestions.monday_update: Search Console clicks have been zero for the last 3 consecutive days (Sep 13–15), compared to 26 clicks in the prior 3 days (Sep 10–12), confirming a real signal rather than noise. The daily verdict attributed this to reduced organic visibility; the 3-day series confirms the drop is sustained. No paid channel is active to compensate. Re-check on Sep 19: if clicks remain at or near zero, escalate to the SEO team for a ranking and indexing audit. Success check: clicks return above 5/day average within the next 3-day window.
